subject: Re: Post-demo: Model fit & next steps / quality follow-up
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Sara Howard <sara@retailco.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-01T15:20:00-07:00
Subject: Post-demo recap + recommended models (RetailCo)

Hi Sara — great to meet you and the RetailCo team today. Thanks for the time and for walking us through the primary user flows. Quick recap and suggested next steps from our side: 

- Primary goal you shared: reduce manual tagging and speed up customer support resolutions for returns and sizing questions (priority: Q2).
- Recommended model fit: for short-form support replies we recommended redwood-7b-quant for cost/latency balance; for more nuanced contextual replies (multi-turn) we suggested redwood-13b-chat (quantized) as an option for critical flows.
- I've attached the prompt set we discussed (RetailCo_prompt_set_v1.csv) and a short benchmark summary (benchmark-results-may2027.pdf) that shows token latency and quality delta vs. baseline for both models.

Next steps:
1) Can you share 2–3 real examples (anonymized) of the most common support threads? We can run a quick eval against the prompt set.
2) If you want, we can schedule a 30-min follow-up next week to review model evals and talk rollout options (canary vs. pinning).
3) I'll loop in product/infra for any questions about pinning a model version to a Dedicated pool.

Thanks — Marissa
Marissa Cole | Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: RetailCo_prompt_set_v1.csv, benchmark-results-may2027.pdf
From: Sara Howard <sara@retailco.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-03T09:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap + recommended models (RetailCo)

Hi Marissa — thanks for the recap and materials. Sharing three anonymized examples now (attached in a separate email). Quick question after scanning the benchmark: we ran a small internal test last week against our staging endpoint and noticed occasional hallucination on product sizing questions when context includes prior returns. Before we run a full eval, can you confirm whether we should prefer the 13b for higher quality or the 7b for latency/cost? Interested in a recommendation for a canary configuration.

Also looping in procurement separately for contracting next steps.

— Sara
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Sara Howard <sara@retailco.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-04T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap + recommended models (RetailCo)

Thanks Sara — good flag on the hallucination. Short guidance: start with redwood-7b-quant for non-critical short replies and redwood-13b-chat for the templates where context/recall matter (returns history, exchange policy interpretation). For the canary, recommend: 80/20 split (80% 7b, 20% 13b) for live testing on a fraction of traffic. We'll run your examples against both and share a per-example scoring. 

Rishi & Dev — could you run a quick diff test on the examples Sara will send and include prompt-engineering suggestions? I attached the prompt set we discussed.

Next: Sara, expect results by EOD Friday. If useful, we'll include candidate prompts that reduce hallucination.

— Marissa
From: Sara Howard <sara@retailco.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: RetailCo Procurement <procurement@retailco.com>
Date: 2027-05-07T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap + recommended models (RetailCo)

Marissa — we ran the quick eval over the weekend against the latest model bundle you provisioned (redwood-13b-chat v20270501 -> production) and after a recent vendor update this morning we saw a noticeable quality regression on ~12% of test cases (examples attached in this thread). The problems are: incorrect policy references, missing prior-return context, and one case where size recommendation contradicts product meta. We can share diffs/examples — attaching three failing examples.

This is concerning for our pilot since accuracy on those cases is a gating factor for going live. Can you advise on rollback/pinning options while you investigate? We prefer pinning to last known-good version if possible.

Thanks, Sara
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Sara Howard <sara@retailco.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-07T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap + recommended models (RetailCo)

Sara — really appreciate the quick heads-up and the example diffs. Looping in Rishi (Head of Product) and Dev (Infra) to triage. Rishi — can you confirm whether the vendor update described lines up with a model param change on our side or an upstream rebuild? If we have a last-known-good model snapshot for RetailCo we should pin them to it immediately. Dev — can you share the rollback runbook and ETA to pin a model version to RetailCo's Dedicated pool?

Proposed immediate action:
- Pin RetailCo to redwood-13b-chat@v20270501 (if available) and route only their pilot traffic there until we validate.
- Run a quick A/B using their three failing examples across pinned version and latest to collect diffs.
- If regression persists upstream, open a formal escalation with model ops and schedule a rollback to last good artifact.

I attached the prompt set for reference. Will follow up after Rishi/Dev confirm.

— Marissa

Attachments: RetailCo_prompt_set_v1.csv
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Sara Howard <sara@retailco.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-07T15:30:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Post-demo recap + recommended models (RetailCo)

Hi all — quick update after triage: the behavior lines up with a minor tokenization/kernel optimization release in the serving runtime that landed this week. We have a snapshot for retail pilot customers: redwood-13b-chat@v20270501. Dev, can you run the pin and the A/B tests? Dev, please confirm estimated downtime/risk and add rollback-runbook.md to the thread.

If pinning is quick we can avoid a full rollback; pinning will route RetailCo traffic to the snapshot while we dig into the root cause. We'll also push a prompt tweak suggestion (reduce hallucination by prompting with explicit policy excerpts).

Thanks — Rishi
From: Dev Patel <dev@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Sara Howard <sara@retailco.com>
Date: 2027-05-10T09:30:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Post-demo recap + recommended models (RetailCo)

All — I've executed the pin request for RetailCo. Details:
- Pinned: redwood-13b-chat@v20270501 to RetailCo Dedicated pool (pilot route).
- Completed A/B run on the three failing examples: pinned version matched expected outputs on all three; latest version failed two of three. Full A/B results uploaded to the Drive link above.
- Risk: pin is safe and reversible; no downtime for production traffic since this applies only to pilot route.
- Runbook: rollback-runbook.md attached for internal ops.

Next steps for sales/CS: confirm with RetailCo that pinned behavior resolves their examples; we'll keep the pin for 72 hours while product & model ops investigate the regression. After 72 hours we can propose a canary re-release if root cause is fixed.

— Dev

Attachments: rollback-runbook.md
